title: Stack-like structure of the direct limit algebra
html:
Remark. Stack-like structure of the direct limit algebra

The direct limit algebra \mathcal{A}_\infty (direct limit algebra) is a global "stack-like" version of the local \mathrm{SU}_q(2) deformations. At each point p \in M, the fibre algebra \mathcal{O}_{q(p)}(\mathrm{SU}(2)) defines a local twisted deformation [yekutieli2008]. The direct limit assembles these into a global object on the jet shell J^\infty E (jet shell).
